promptBase: Panoramic hand-painted architectural watercolor for a light WinUI world-clock column; exact 16:9 landscape; airy travel-sketch quality; restrained graphite underdrawing; broad translucent pigment masses; softly feathered edges; recognizable but not photographic. Keep the central area quiet for a large circular UI overlay, with the urban mass mostly in the lower 65% and the primary landmark on a lateral third. Real RGBA transparency outside the skyline; no sky, paper rectangle, checkerboard, border, text, people, vehicles, flags, logos, sun, moon, weather icon, signature, or watermark.

seasonalModes.true-winter: Distinct cold-season treatment; snow or frost only where climatologically plausible.
seasonalModes.mild-winter: Cooler light, bare or muted vegetation and wetter atmosphere; avoid implausible heavy snow.
seasonalModes.wet-dry: Express local wet and dry seasons instead of a European four-season stereotype.
seasonalModes.palette-only: Keep geometry and vegetation nearly constant; distinguish variants mainly through light, haze and palette.
